components.name: SphereAgent
components.summary: The sphere roller's agent next to the sphere's Transform and RigidBody: task settings and episode state.

fields.name: behavior
fields.desc: the trainer's behaviour name (required) (default "SphereRoller")

fields.name: max_torque
fields.desc: N m for an action component of 1 (default 20.0)

fields.name: speed_range
fields.desc: target speeds, m/s ... (default glm::vec2(0.5, 3.0))

fields.name: stop_chance
fields.desc: ... or 0 with this probability (default 0.1)

fields.name: turn_rate
fields.desc: rad/s of the target heading toward its goal (default 0.7)

fields.name: acceleration
fields.desc: m/s^2 of the target speed toward its goal (default 0.75)

fields.name: goal_interval
fields.desc: seconds between goal draws (default glm::vec2(2.0, 6.0))

fields.name: max_goal_turn
fields.desc: rad: a new goal heading within this of the current one (default 2.1)

fields.name: home_radius
fields.desc: beyond it from the spawn point, new goal headings point back (+- 45 deg); 0: off (default 30.0)

fields.name: bounds
fields.desc: |x| or |z| beyond it truncates the episode; 0: off (default 55.0)

fields.name: fall_depth
fields.desc: this far below the spawn point truncates the episode (default 100.0)

fields.name: spawn_radius
fields.desc: spawn points within it of the spawn centre, on the ground (default 10.0)

fields.name: spawn_spacing
fields.desc: m: world i spawns around (i * spawn_spacing, 0) (vr_roller: two players apart) (default 0.0)

fields.name: stagger
fields.desc: the trainer's RESET starts each agent at a random point of its episode (default true)

fields.name: reward_scale
fields.desc: r = exp(-|v_xz - v*| / reward_scale) per tick, m/s (default 1.0)

fields.name: probe_distance
fields.desc: horizontal distance of the look-ahead normals, m (default 1.0)

fields.name: max_decisions
fields.desc: decisions per episode (at least 1) (default 600)

fields.name: steered
fields.desc: a player sets the goal (steerSphere, VRRoller): no goal draws, no time limit (default false)

fields.name: home
fields.desc: Episode state / the episode's spawn point (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: heading
fields.desc: the live target: heading (rad) and speed (m/s) (default 0.0)

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: live target speed, m/s (default 0.0)

fields.name: goal_heading
fields.desc: heading the live target turns toward, rad (default 0.0)

fields.name: goal_speed
fields.desc: speed the live target moves toward, m/s (default 0.0)

fields.name: goal_timer
fields.desc: seconds before the next goal draw (default 0.0)

fields.name: decision_target
fields.desc: the target velocity of the last observation: rewards use it (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: decision_heading
fields.desc: ... and its frame converts the action to a world torque (default 0.0)

fields.name: has_decision
fields.desc: an observation went out in this episode: the action answers it (default false)

fields.name: torque
fields.desc: world torque held over the window (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: reward_sum
fields.desc: sum of the window's per-tick rewards (default 0.)

fields.name: error_sum
fields.desc: sum of the window's horizontal speed errors, m/s (default 0.)

fields.name: reward_ticks
fields.desc: ticks summed in the window (default 0)

fields.name: decisions
fields.desc: decisions of the episode (default 0)

fields.name: ended
fields.desc: the episode ends with this window (default false)

fields.name: out_of_bounds
fields.desc: it ended off the field or by a fall (default false)

fields.name: pending_reset
fields.desc: the terminal observation went out: new episode at the next window (default false)

components.notes: One per world (SphereControl expects exactly one entity with SphereAgent, Transform and RigidBody). JSON reads the settings only (behavior to steered); the episode state is the systems'. Validation: behavior not empty, max_decisions >= 1, 0 <= speed_range.x <= speed_range.y, 0 < goal_interval.x <= goal_interval.y, reward_scale > 0. steerSphere() writes goal_heading and goal_speed for a steered agent (VRRoller, DesktopRoller).

components.name: PursuitDot
components.summary: A chaser or a runner of the pursuit fixture, next to its AgentIO component.

fields.name: chaser
fields.desc: a chaser (else a runner) (default false)

fields.name: position

fields.name: velocity
fields.desc: x, z, m/s, from the last displacement (default glm::vec2(0.0))

fields.name: yaw
fields.desc: radians about +y, 0 looks down -z, positive to the left (default 0.0)

fields.name: stamina
fields.desc: 0..1, drained while sprinting (default 1.0)

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: the held speed action, 0..1 (default 0.0)

fields.name: turn
fields.desc: the held turn action, -1..1 (default 0.0)

fields.name: sprint
fields.desc: the held discrete action: sprinting (default false)

fields.name: phase
fields.desc: a runner decides on windows where (window + phase) % runner_every == 0 (default 0)

fields.name: decisions
fields.desc: decisions of its episode (default 0)

fields.name: reward
fields.desc: since its last decision (default 0.)

fields.name: nearest
fields.desc: a chaser: how far the nearest runner was at its last decision, < 0 none (default -1.0)

fields.name: catches
fields.desc: a chaser's catches since its last decision (default 0)

fields.name: fresh
fields.desc: no observation of this episode went out yet (default true)

fields.name: caught

components.name: PursuitField
components.summary: World context of the pursuit fixture: its parameters and counters.

fields.name: params
fields.desc: the Pursuit system's parameters: field, chasers, runners, catch_radius, speed, sprint, turn_rate, stamina_drain, stamina_gain, chaser_decisions, runner_decisions, runner_every, alive_reward, others, runners_still, approach_reward

fields.name: windows
fields.desc: decision windows observed (PursuitObserve) (default 0)

fields.name: catches
fields.desc: catches since the start (Pursuit) (default 0)

fields.name: births
fields.desc: runners born after one ended (Pursuit) (default 0)

components.notes: Emplaced by Pursuit in preinit; read by PursuitObserve. PursuitParams (same header) holds the defaults listed on the Pursuit page.

components.name: GroundField
components.summary: The world's ground as a density function: what the kinematic walk, the routes and the animals' gaits plant feet on, with no collider.

fields.name: version
fields.desc: counts changes of the ground (PlaneField::setTilt): planted feet are fitted again (default 0)

components.notes: Stored as std::shared_ptr<GroundField> (abstract class: density(p) > 0 inside, below(from, distance), top(x, z), height(x, z, from_y, fallback)). Implementations: PlaneField (tilted plane: origin, pitch, roll, normal) set by GroundPlane, TerrainField (marching cubes of the TerrainGenerator's samples, lazily meshed blocks of 4^3 cubes, at most 4096 cached) set by GroundTerrain. groundField(reg) emplaces a level PlaneField at y = 0 when none exists. AgentFactory, AnimalFactory, herds, steering and gait scenes copy the pointer in init. Not thread safe (TerrainField's cache is mutable).

components.name: WalkRoutes
components.summary: Slope band and spawn area of a walker's routes on uneven ground; on the entity with HumanBotSpawn.

fields.name: up
fields.desc: steepest climb along a path (20 degrees) (default 0.349066)

fields.name: down
fields.desc: steepest descent along it (7 degrees: beyond, the kinematic walk's swing knee passes 95 degrees) (default 0.122173)

fields.name: across
fields.desc: steepest slope across it (12 degrees) (default 0.209440)

fields.name: length
fields.desc: m of path ahead that must stay in the band (default 12.0)

fields.name: half_width
fields.desc: m to each side of the path that must stay in it too (default 1.0)

fields.name: clear
fields.desc: m around a spawn point where the ground is no steeper than the least of the three, whatever the direction (default 1.5)

fields.name: centre
fields.desc: spawn points are drawn within spawn_radius of it (x, z) (default glm::vec2(0.0))

fields.name: spawn_radius
fields.desc: m around centre where spawn points are drawn (default 1000.0)

fields.name: direction_tries
fields.desc: directions tried from a point, spread evenly around it (default 96)

fields.name: spawn_tries
fields.desc: points tried for a spawn (default 20000)

components.notes: Angles are radians in the component, degrees in JSON (each between 0 and 80). Validation: length > 0, spawn_radius >= 0, direction_tries and spawn_tries >= 1. Read by drawStart / drawDirection (GaitRoutes, and the physical walker's Task on the terrain); GaitRoutes overrides length with the episode's path length on a copy.

components.name: GaitRoute
components.summary: The route the kinematic walker is recording (GaitRoutes), on the rig entity.

fields.name: episode
fields.desc: routes started so far (default 0)

fields.name: found
fields.desc: drawn in the slope band (default false)

fields.name: from
fields.desc: the route's start point, on the ground (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: direction
fields.desc: horizontal unit direction of the route (default glm::vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0))

fields.name: start_tick
fields.desc: WorldClock tick at which the route started (default 0)

fields.name: warm_ticks
fields.desc: ticks walked before recording, whole windows (default 0)

components.notes: Emplaced and written by GaitRoutes only.

components.name: IKChain
components.summary: A chain of a rig's joints from root to tip, solved by Fabrik; one entity per chain.

fields.name: rig
fields.desc: the rig entity (Rig + RigPose) (default entt::null)

fields.name: name
fields.desc: for logs and views ("left leg", "right arm")

fields.name: joints
fields.desc: joint indices root to tip, each one's child the next one's parent; the target position is for the last joint's anchor

fields.name: pole_rest
fields.desc: where the inner joints point at the rest pose (zero: no pole) (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: limits
fields.desc: clamp to the rig model's joint limits (default true)

fields.name: yield
fields.desc: ... unless the tip then misses its target: the limits give way (default false)

fields.name: solved
fields.desc: The last solve (default false)

fields.name: iterations
fields.desc: FABRIK iterations of the last solve (default 0)

fields.name: position_error
fields.desc: The last solve / m between the tip anchor and the target (default 0.0)

fields.name: rotation_error
fields.desc: radians between the tip segment and the target (default 0.0)

fields.name: limit_excess
fields.desc: radians the limits took away, or would have (yielded), the worst joint (default 0.0)

fields.name: yielded
fields.desc: the limits gave way on this solve (default false)

components.notes: Entities created by GaitFootIK (legs) and GaitHandIK (arms), destroyed by GaitRoutes at a new route (legs). Fabrik writes the last-solve fields; GaitBalance and GaitChecks read them.

components.name: IKTarget
components.summary: What a system wants from an IKChain; any number per chain, the highest priority wins, equal priorities blend by weight.

fields.name: chain
fields.desc: the chain entity (default entt::null)

fields.name: position
fields.desc: world, of the tip joint's anchor (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: rotation
fields.desc: world, of the tip segment (default glm::quat(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))

fields.name: use_rotation
fields.desc: the tip segment takes the target rotation (default true)

fields.name: pole
fields.desc: world direction; zero: the chain's rest pole carried by the root's parent (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: weight
fields.desc: blend weight among equal priorities; a total under 1 blends the solution with the pose found (default 1.0)

fields.name: priority
fields.desc: the highest among enabled targets wins (default 0)

fields.name: enabled
fields.desc: disabled targets are ignored (default true)

fields.name: owner
fields.desc: the system that updates it

components.notes: One entity per target. Written every tick by its owner (GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK); read by Fabrik and GaitBalance.

components.name: RigPose
components.summary: A rig's pose as joint angles: the pelvis' world pose and one constraint-frame rotation per joint (identity at rest).

fields.name: root_position
fields.desc: world position of the pelvis segment (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: root_rotation
fields.desc: world rotation of the pelvis segment (default glm::quat(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))

fields.name: joint
fields.desc: per joint, rotation in its constraint frame (X twist, Y plane, Z normal)

fields.name: teleport
fields.desc: the next RigPoseApply sets the bodies instead of moving them (default true)

components.notes: On the rig entity (the one with HumanBotSpawn), created at the spawn pose by ensureRig. GaitBase writes it, GaitBalance places the pelvis, Fabrik corrects the chains, RigPoseApply moves the kinematic bodies to it.

components.name: Rig
components.summary: The rig of a world: the kinematic tree of the body file (RigModel), next to RigPose.

fields.name: model
fields.desc: forward kinematics, joint frames and conversions, IK limits (limits, enlargeable) and body file limits, segment masses

components.notes: Created by ensureRig from HumanBot::body on the first call of any gait or IK system. The RigModel is shared and mutable: GaitFootIK widens the ankles' IK limits in it.

components.name: GaitCommand
components.summary: What the kinematic walker is asked to do: speed, heading, where it starts.

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: m/s, horizontal (default 1.36)

fields.name: heading
fields.desc: radians about +y; 0 walks toward -z (default 0.0)

fields.name: start
fields.desc: x, z where it stands at the first tick (default glm::vec2(0.0))

components.notes: On the rig entity. JSON heading in degrees (radians in the component), speed >= 0. Emplaced with defaults by any gait system when missing; GaitRoutes writes start and heading at every route.

components.name: GaitParams
components.summary: The kinematic gait's laws and shapes (angles in radians, lengths in metres).

fields.name: step_factor
fields.desc: Step length / leg length = step_factor * (speed / sqrt(g * leg length)) ^ step_exponent; the stride never lasts longer than max_stride_time (slow walking shortens the step instead) (default 1.11)

fields.name: step_exponent
fields.desc: Step length / leg length = step_factor * (speed / sqrt(g * leg length)) ^ step_exponent; the stride never lasts longer than max_stride_time (slow walking shortens the step instead) (default 0.42)

fields.name: max_stride_time
fields.desc: Step length / leg length = step_factor * (speed / sqrt(g * leg length)) ^ step_exponent; the stride never lasts longer than max_stride_time (slow walking shortens the step instead) (default 1.6)

fields.name: stance_share
fields.desc: Share of the stride a foot is on the ground: stance_share at reference_speed, changing with speed / rate per m/s (default 0.62)

fields.name: stance_share_rate
fields.desc: Share of the stride a foot is on the ground: stance_share at reference_speed, changing with speed / rate per m/s (default -0.055)

fields.name: reference_speed
fields.desc: Share of the stride a foot is on the ground: stance_share at reference_speed, changing with speed / rate per m/s (default 1.36)

fields.name: step_width
fields.desc: between the sole centres' paths (default 0.14)

fields.name: flat_start
fields.desc: Stance, as shares of its duration: heel rocker until flat_start, flat until heel_off, then the toe rocker (default 0.16)

fields.name: heel_off
fields.desc: Stance, as shares of its duration: heel rocker until flat_start, flat until heel_off, then the toe rocker (default 0.5)

fields.name: strike_angle
fields.desc: Stance, as shares of its duration: heel rocker until flat_start, flat until heel_off, then the toe rocker / sole pitch at heel strike and at toe-off, at reference_speed (default 0.26)

fields.name: toe_angle
fields.desc: Stance, as shares of its duration: heel rocker until flat_start, flat until heel_off, then the toe rocker / sole pitch at heel strike and at toe-off, at reference_speed (default 1.05)

fields.name: swing_lift
fields.desc: extra ankle arc; least gap between the sole and the ground (default 0.03)

fields.name: swing_clearance
fields.desc: extra ankle arc; least gap between the sole and the ground (default 0.025)

fields.name: swing_level
fields.desc: share of the swing by which the sole has turned from its toe-off pitch to its landing pitch (default 0.6)

fields.name: replan_until
fields.desc: share of the swing during which the landing is still planned (default 0.6)

fields.name: max_heel_rise
fields.desc: the most the toe rocker pitches the sole, radians (default 1.4)

fields.name: heel_drop_rate
fields.desc: rad/s: how fast a heel raised for reach or for the ankle comes back down (default 2.5)

fields.name: ankle_margin
fields.desc: the heel rises when the ankle is this close to its dorsiflexion stop (default 0.035)

fields.name: knee_follow
fields.desc: in a turn the knee points this share of the way from the pelvis' forward to the foot's (default 0.5)

fields.name: knee_out
fields.desc: the knee points this share of the way from the walker's forward to the foot's toes (default 0.5)

fields.name: ankle_roll_extra
fields.desc: Added to the ankles' swing limits for the IK only, about the foot's long axis (roll) and the sole's normal (yaw). 0: the body file's, which were widened for 15 degree side slopes (assets.md) (default 0.0)

fields.name: ankle_yaw_extra
fields.desc: Added to the ankles' swing limits for the IK only, about the foot's long axis (roll) and the sole's normal (yaw). 0: the body file's, which were widened for 15 degree side slopes (assets.md) (default 0.0)

fields.name: yield_limits
fields.desc: A planted foot comes first: where a leg cannot put its foot on its print inside the joint limits, the limits give way (steep ground). false: the limits always hold and the foot misses its print (default true)

fields.name: leg_extension
fields.desc: Pelvis and trunk / most of the thigh + shank length a leg stretches to (the knee keeps 14 degrees) (default 0.992)

fields.name: hip_height
fields.desc: the hips' height over the ankles in mid stance, as a share of that reach (default 1.0)

fields.name: bob
fields.desc: the hips sink this much at each double support, at reference_speed (default 0.035)

fields.name: crouch_time
fields.desc: seconds: how fast the hips settle to the crouch the last step needed (default 0.35)

fields.name: pelvis_yaw
fields.desc: amplitudes at reference_speed (default 0.07)

fields.name: pelvis_list
fields.desc: amplitudes at reference_speed (default 0.035)

fields.name: counter_rotation
fields.desc: shoulders turn against the pelvis by this share of its yaw (default 0.6)

fields.name: lean
fields.desc: trunk pitch at reference_speed; per radian of slope along the heading (default 0.035)

fields.name: lean_slope_gain
fields.desc: trunk pitch at reference_speed; per radian of slope along the heading (default 0.5)

fields.name: arm_swing
fields.desc: arm swing amplitude at reference_speed, radians (default 0.32)

fields.name: arm_bias
fields.desc: arms held forward by this at reference_speed, radians (default 0.05)

fields.name: elbow
fields.desc: elbow bend, radians (default 0.17)

fields.name: elbow_swing
fields.desc: extra elbow bend as the arm swings forward, radians (default 0.2)

fields.name: acceleration
fields.desc: Command following (default 1.0)

fields.name: turn_rate
fields.desc: Command following (default 0.7)

fields.name: min_speed
fields.desc: Command following (default 0.05)

fields.name: slope_slowdown
fields.desc: Command following / the speed walked is the command times exp(-slope_slowdown * |tan slope|), (default 1.5)

fields.name: slope_speed_floor
fields.desc: ... and no less than this share of it, however steep, (default 0.25)

fields.name: step_rise
fields.desc: ... but slow enough that a step climbs or drops no more than this, m (0: no such cap) (default 0.35)

fields.name: look_ahead
fields.desc: m ahead of the walker where a steeper slope already slows it (default 0.8)

fields.name: braking
fields.desc: m/s2, slowing down (acceleration is for speeding up) (default 2.5)

fields.name: max_print_rise
fields.desc: m between a foot's landing and the other foot's print: the step shortens to keep it (default 0.5)

fields.name: max_print_tilt
fields.desc: radians: steeper ground than this (75 degrees) is stood on at this tilt (default 1.31)

fields.name: balance_iterations
fields.desc: GaitBalance's iterations of the pelvis placement (default 8)

fields.name: balance_tolerance
fields.desc: m of centre of mass error at which GaitBalance stops (default 3e-4)

fields.name: velocity_smoothing
fields.desc: Balance / seconds, the centre of mass velocity filter (default 0.08)

fields.name: scramble
fields.desc: Scrambling (GaitHandIK in the lane): the steeper the ground, the lower the trunk, and a hand that comes within reach of the ground lays its palm flat on it (default false)

fields.name: scramble_from
fields.desc: Scrambling (GaitHandIK in the lane): the steeper the ground, the lower the trunk, and a hand that comes within reach of the ground lays its palm flat on it / radians of slope (20 and 50 degrees) between which the trunk comes down (default 0.35)

fields.name: scramble_full
fields.desc: Scrambling (GaitHandIK in the lane): the steeper the ground, the lower the trunk, and a hand that comes within reach of the ground lays its palm flat on it / radians of slope (20 and 50 degrees) between which the trunk comes down (default 0.87)

fields.name: scramble_crouch
fields.desc: the hips come down by this share of the legs' reach on the steepest ground, (default 0.15)

fields.name: scramble_shoulder
fields.desc: ... and the trunk tilts toward the slope until the shoulders are this far from the ground, m, (default 0.3)

fields.name: scramble_lean
fields.desc: ... by this much at most, radians, (default 1.5)

fields.name: scramble_past
fields.desc: ... and no further than this past lying along the slope, radians. (default 0.5)

fields.name: scramble_forward
fields.desc: Then the centre of mass target moves up the slope, by this at most, m: the hands will take weight (default 0.45)

fields.name: scramble_spine
fields.desc: radians each of the two spine joints bends for that tilt; the pelvis tips for the rest (default 0.42)

fields.name: hand_plant_reach
fields.desc: a hand takes a hold no further from its shoulder than this share of the arm, (default 0.86)

fields.name: hand_reach
fields.desc: ... and keeps it until the arm is stretched to this share (default 0.97)

fields.name: hand_behind
fields.desc: m behind its shoulder from where a hand moves on to a hold ahead, if there is one, (default 0.12)

fields.name: hand_over
fields.desc: ... or radians its arm is outside its limits, (default 0.35)

fields.name: hand_hold
fields.desc: ... once it has held for this long, seconds (default 0.4)

fields.name: hand_time
fields.desc: seconds a hand takes to reach a hold, or to go back to its swing (default 0.3)

fields.name: hand_lift
fields.desc: m off the ground on its way (default 0.05)

fields.name: hand_max_tilt
fields.desc: radians: steeper ground than this (85 degrees) is held at this tilt (default 1.48)

fields.name: trunk_reach
fields.desc: radians the trunk leans further so that a planted hand stays within reach (default 0.35)

fields.name: trunk_return
fields.desc: seconds for that lean to go once no hand asks for it (default 0.4)

fields.name: hand_support
fields.desc: the centre of mass target moves this share of the way to each planted palm (default 0.1)

components.notes: On the rig entity. JSON reads only a subset (step_factor, step_exponent, max_stride_time, stance_share, step_width, strike_angle, toe_angle, swing_lift, swing_clearance, leg_extension, hip_height, lean_slope_gain, acceleration, turn_rate, slope_slowdown, slope_speed_floor, step_rise, knee_out, yield_limits, ankle_roll_extra, ankle_yaw_extra, scramble, scramble_from, scramble_full, scramble_crouch, scramble_lean, scramble_shoulder, hand_time, hand_support, trunk_reach); its angles are in degrees there. Emplaced with defaults by any gait system when missing.

components.name: GaitState
components.summary: The kinematic walk's state: clock, command followed, gait laws of the tick, feet, hands and scrambling.

fields.name: started
fields.desc: GaitBase's first tick is done (default false)

fields.name: feet_ready
fields.desc: GaitFootIK made the legs' chains and prints (default false)

fields.name: time
fields.desc: seconds walked (default 0.)

fields.name: phase
fields.desc: of the stride, 0 at the left heel strike (default 0.0)

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: the command, followed at the allowed rates and slowed by the slope (default 0.0)

fields.name: heading
fields.desc: the command, followed at the allowed rates and slowed by the slope (default 0.0)

fields.name: wanted_speed
fields.desc: what the speed is heading for (default 0.0)

fields.name: moving
fields.desc: the command or the speed is over min_speed (default false)

fields.name: centre
fields.desc: the walker's reference point on the ground (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: ground_version
fields.desc: GroundField::version the prints were fitted on (default 0)

fields.name: leg_length
fields.desc: This tick's gait laws / hip to sole; the longest hip to ankle distance (default 0.96)

fields.name: reach
fields.desc: This tick's gait laws / hip to sole; the longest hip to ankle distance (default 0.84)

fields.name: fold
fields.desc: the shortest hip to ankle distance (scrambling) (default 0.36)

fields.name: step_length
fields.desc: m (default 0.0)

fields.name: stride_time
fields.desc: s (default 1.0)

fields.name: stance_share
fields.desc: share of the stride a foot is down (default 0.62)

fields.name: amplitude
fields.desc: step length over the one at reference_speed, 0..1.25 (default 0.0)

fields.name: omega
fields.desc: sqrt(g / height of the centre of mass) (default 3.1)

fields.name: capture_offset
fields.desc: the heel lands this far behind the extrapolated centre of mass (default 0.0)

fields.name: sway
fields.desc: lateral offset of the centre of mass target, along the walker's right (default 0.0)

fields.name: slope_pitch
fields.desc: of the ground along and across the heading (uphill, right side up) (default 0.0)

fields.name: slope_roll
fields.desc: of the ground along and across the heading (uphill, right side up) (default 0.0)

fields.name: steepness
fields.desc: tan of the steepest slope under or just ahead of the walker (default 0.0)

fields.name: lean
fields.desc: trunk pitch, radians (default 0.0)

fields.name: hip_centre
fields.desc: between the hip joints, before GaitBalance (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: pivot
fields.desc: the same point in the pelvis frame (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: com_target
fields.desc: x, z (default glm::vec2(0.0))

fields.name: foot
fields.desc: left, right: geometry, IK chain and target entities, contact, prints, rockers, swing, pose (FootState)

fields.name: hands_ready
fields.desc: Scrambling (default false)

fields.name: hand
fields.desc: left, right: geometry, IK chain and target entities, contact, prints, grip, timers, pose (HandState)

fields.name: low
fields.desc: 0 upright, 1 as low as the steepest ground brings the trunk (default 0.0)

fields.name: tilt
fields.desc: radians the pelvis and the trunk tilt toward the slope, along the heading and to the right (default glm::vec2(0.0))

fields.name: forward
fields.desc: m the centre of mass target is moved up the slope, at low = 1 (default 0.0)

fields.name: shoulder_gap
fields.desc: m from the shoulders to the ground, as GaitBase last saw them (default 0.0)

fields.name: uphill
fields.desc: horizontal unit vector up the slope under the walker (zero on level ground) (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: trunk_reach
fields.desc: the trunk's lean for the hands, a world rotation vector (default glm::vec3(0.0))

components.notes: On the rig entity, emplaced by the gait systems; GaitRoutes replaces it at every route (the gait starts over). The entities named in foot[] and hand[] are owned by GaitFootIK and GaitHandIK.

components.name: BalanceState
components.summary: The kinematic walk's balance, written by GaitBalance each tick: centre of mass, crouch, support, capture.

fields.name: valid
fields.desc: written at least once (default false)

fields.name: com
fields.desc: centre of mass of the solved pose (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: velocity
fields.desc: filtered centre of mass velocity (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: xcom
fields.desc: extrapolated centre of mass on the ground: com + velocity / omega (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: ground
fields.desc: height of the ground under the centre of mass (default 0.0)

fields.name: lead
fields.desc: m the extrapolated centre of mass is ahead of the reference point (default 0.0)

fields.name: error
fields.desc: m left between the centre of mass and its target (default 0.0)

fields.name: iterations
fields.desc: pelvis placement iterations this tick (default 0)

fields.name: crouch
fields.desc: m the hips sit under their nominal height (default 0.0)

fields.name: bias
fields.desc: m of that held through the stride, so the hips move smoothly (default 0.0)

fields.name: deficit
fields.desc: the most reach this step lacked so far (default 0.0)

fields.name: wanted
fields.desc: what bias is settling to (default 0.0)

fields.name: lift
fields.desc: m the hips are held up so that the knees do not fold past their stop (scrambling) (default 0.0)

fields.name: lift_room
fields.desc: the least the legs' reach left over the hips in the last step (default 10.0)

fields.name: lift_room_step
fields.desc: the same in this step so far (default 10.0)

fields.name: offset
fields.desc: where the hips ended, from where GaitBase put them (default glm::vec3(0.0))

fields.name: support
fields.desc: convex hull of the soles' last and next prints and of the planted palms, x z

fields.name: outside
fields.desc: m the centre of mass is outside it (default 0.0)

fields.name: lateral_margin
fields.desc: m from the extrapolated centre of mass to the stance foot's outer edge (default 0.0)

fields.name: captured
fields.desc: a heel struck on this tick (default false)

fields.name: capture_error
fields.desc: m along the heading between that heel and xcom - capture_offset (default 0.0)

components.notes: On the rig entity, emplaced by GaitBalance; read on the next tick by GaitBase, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, and by GaitChecks; removed by GaitRoutes at a new route.

fields.name: penetration

fields.name: max_penetration
